snippet.title: Anik Singal
snippet.description:
In May 2022, everything changed.

I was about to sell my 9-figure company. Retire. Focus on my kids.
Then the FTC showed up.

18 months. $15M gone.
A brutal lawsuit that almost ended everything.

But I didn’t quit.

I fought back—and built something better!
 
A first-of-its-kind AI-powered software that helps marketing and sales teams automatically audit and monitor their advertising for compliance.

And guess what? It’s working.

Because of the FTC, I stumbled onto something incredible—a solution that could protect thousands of businesses from the same challenges I faced.

📈 What I Do Now

Today, through my new holding company Ugentic AI, I invest in and partner with AI & Martech SaaS companies, using the same growth strategies that helped scale my past businesses.

💰 If you own an innovative AI or Martech SaaS company with a fully built-out product and are looking for an investor who can help you scale faster—let’s talk.

snippet.title: Self Publishing Empire
snippet.description:
I'm Craig and I'm turning my online side hustle on Amazon KDP into a Self Publishing Empire through self publishing low, medium, and high content books online via Amazon KDP.

Join me as I turn my side hustle into a full-time online passive income stream in an aim to achieve financial freedom. I'll be completely transparent and share everything along the way from honest income reports, to money making tips, Amazon Ads strategies, advice on how to publish books,  the best publishing tools, AI software, walkthroughs, and more!

My goal focuses on producing books, researching new and innovative tools like text-to-image AI, discovering new ways to make money online, and creating a passive income stream.

This channel focuses mostly on book publishing through Amazon KDP,  but stretches across other platforms such as Etsy to experiment with additional ways to make money online.

Subscribe to follow my progress by signing up to my email list here: https://subscribepage.io/GmKXTh

snippet.title: JeffSetLife
snippet.description:
I believe anyone can become self-sufficient when it comes to making money online.

My Story:
I started with sales funnel automation, flipping products on eBay, and learning how to sell. That led me to Amazon KDP publishing, where I built consistent royalties month after month. From there, I expanded into affiliate marketing, digital products, and now YouTube, turning my journey into a platform that helps others do the same.

The biggest lesson? Financial freedom comes from building skills and staying consistent, not luck.

On this channel, I share everything I’ve learned from KDP, affiliate marketing, digital products, and YouTube, so you can skip the guesswork and build sustainable income streams.

This channel isn’t just about making money, it’s about creating a lifestyle where you call the shots.

Find me across all platforms: @JeffSetLife 📲
